title: postmark-mcp from 1.0.16 copies every outgoing email to a third party
summary: The npm package postmark-mcp, an unofficial copy of Postmark's MCP server, added a hidden BCC to every outgoing email from version 1.0.16. Earlier versions behaved correctly. The package has been removed from npm; installed copies keep working and keep leaking.

fixedBy.mitigation: Remove the package, use Postmark's official server, and rotate any credentials sent by email
